newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street eases off opening highs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street eases off opening highs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks eased off opening highs prompted by lower-than-expected April inflation numbers.
The Dow industrials were up 36 at 7310 after rising 77 points at the opening. The New York Stock Exchange imposed trading curbs at 0934 EDT/1334 GMT.
The Nasdaq composite index was off 3.36 to 1330.23. The Nasdaq was weighed by a slump in Intel Corp, which faces a patent infringement suits brought by Digital Equipment.
The long bond is up 21/32 to yield 6.87 and the S&P index is up 5.46 to 838.59
